objects.name: New Abuse of the ClickOnce Technology, Part 1: The Inner Workings of ClickOnce Application Deployment
objects.description: Dolphins, sharks, turtles, and human workers are all victims of unregulated squid fishing fleets. As usual, you can also use this squid post to talk about the security stories in the news that I haven’t covered.
